title: IAOMS Foundation Programs 2027

2027–2028 IAOMS Foundation Fellowships & Visiting Scholar Programs

Advanced international training and observership opportunities for oral and maxillofacial surgeons.

The IAOMS Foundation connects oral and maxillofacial surgeons with leading institutions, mentors and professional communities around the world through immersive fellowships and focused Visiting Scholar observerships.

Whether you are seeking a year of advanced specialty training, a six-month international fellowship or a short-term observational experience, IAOMS Foundation programs are designed to expand clinical knowledge, strengthen global relationships and help participants bring new skills and perspectives home to their patients, colleagues and communities.

Transform your practice. Strengthen your community. Advance the specialty and patient care.

Applications are now open for 2027–2028.

Applications Opened: October 13, 2026

Application Deadline: Sunday, November 29, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. CST

6-Month Advanced Fellowship

Explore the Visiting Scholars Program

Core Eligibility for 2027–2028 IAOMS Foundation Programs

While each program has its own requirements, all 2027–2028 Foundation Fellowship and Visiting Scholar applicants must meet these core criteria:

  • Be a current IAOMS member with at least two years of membership, meaning membership since October 2024.
  • Have completed basic oral and maxillofacial surgery training by June 30, 2026 and be within five years of completing that training at the time of application.
  • Applicants must be current IAOMS members for a minimum of two years and commit to IAOMS membership through December 31, 2028.
  • Engage fully in the selected program.
  • Share knowledge and experience after returning home.
  • Stay connected with the IAOMS community following the program.

Made Possible Through Partnership

Investing in the Future of Global OMS Education

IAOMS Foundation programs are made possible through the generosity of partners and donors who believe that access to advanced education, mentorship and international collaboration can strengthen oral and maxillofacial surgery and improve patient care worldwide.

Supporting IAOMS Foundation Fellowship & Scholar Programs

The IAOMS Foundation gratefully recognizes KLS Martin and Elsevier for their generous support of Foundation fellowship and scholar programs. Their partnership, along with the support of all partners and individual donors, helps create international training opportunities for surgeons who will carry new knowledge and skills back to their institutions, patients and communities.

A Special Investment in the Qiu Weiliu International Fellowship

The Qiu Weiliu International Fellowship Program is made possible through a generous $50,000 annual gift for three years from Dr. James Chow, a member of the IAOMS Foundation Board of Trustees.

The Foundation also recognizes Dr. Alfred Lau, IAOMS Foundation Trustee, whose leadership and dedication helped bring the program to life and strengthen the collaboration with Shanghai Ninth People’s Hospital.
